item.text:
### (a) Three posts

1. We hold a clear conviction: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will double the pace of scientific discovery. We must prepare now to turn that acceleration into progress for everyone.

2. If we build superintelligent AI within the next 20 years, we will double the pace of scientific discovery. That future deserves serious investment in research, safety and institutions that turn breakthroughs into public benefit.

3. We stand for a future of faster discovery. If superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will double the pace of scientific discovery. Our task is to make that progress safe, accessible and broadly shared.

### (b) Newsletter opening

We hold a clear conviction: if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, it will double the pace of scientific discovery. We see that acceleration as a defining opportunity to advance medicine, develop cleaner energy and deepen our understanding of the world. But faster discovery is not our only goal. We want its benefits to reach people everywhere, and we must build the safeguards and institutions that make that possible. That means investing in rigorous research, responsible development and the public capacity to translate breakthroughs into better lives. We are working toward a future where scientific progress moves twice as fast—and serves the common good.
